the letters sit at searched positions along the path, at least 210 px apart in both sizes, so no two letters stack and the last e no longer lands on the booked square; the counter fades before the cursor reaches it
the outline Zones and the ghost Nudge are stroked at 5 px (a deliberate departure from the brief 2 px): both read at 360 px
the zoom-through, the dive and the fall at the lens blur at 12 subframes: a smear, no discrete copies
Buffer fades on its own 10 frames at the dive, so it no longer crosses the Poll block in the vertical
the snap is stiffer (the string and the letters spring at about 3.5 Hz, a 1-frame stagger): Everyone sits on its baseline by about 00:02.7 instead of 00:02.9
the ring steps are keyed 4 frames earlier so each 90 degree turn arrives on its beat (1560, 1590, 1620)
